source.title: Ophelia Syndrome: Acute Stupor as a Primary Manifestation of Hodgkin Lymphoma Diagnosed by Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography

presentation: A 59-year-old male was admitted for evaluation of lymphoproliferative syndrome under the care of the hematology service. Staging studies demonstrated adenomegalies at the cervical, thoracic, and abdominal levels, alongside pancreatic infiltration.

events.detail: The patient developed respiratory symptoms with impaired oxygenation and alveolar occupancy on chest radiograph.
events.source_span: During the hospitalization, the patient developed respiratory symptoms with impaired oxygenation and alveolar occupancy on chest radiograph, consistent with hospital-acquired pneumonia

events.detail: The respiratory symptoms and pneumonia resolved with appropriate management.
events.source_span: which resolved with appropriate management.

events.detail: The patient was identified to have ascites and pleural effusion.
events.source_span: Concurrently, a polyserositis syndrome was identified, evidenced by ascites and a pleural effusion of mixed characteristics, considered related to the infectious process.

events.detail: The patient developed an unexplained deterioration of consciousness progressing to profound stupor.
events.source_span: Four days after resolution of the infectious episode, the patient presented an unexplained deterioration of consciousness progressing to profound stupor without cranial nerve deficits or clinical seizure activity.

events.detail: The patient was transferred to the intensive care unit for strict neurological monitoring.
events.source_span: He was transferred to the intensive care unit (ICU) for strict neurological monitoring.

events.detail: An initial structural neuroimaging approach via brain MRI with contrast at 3 Tesla, including an epilepsy protocol, was performed.
events.source_span: An initial structural neuroimaging approach via brain MRI with contrast at 3 Tesla, including an epilepsy protocol,

events.detail: The MRI showed no signal alterations in the medial temporal lobes, no acute vascular events, and no leptomeningeal enhancement, with only mild cortical involutive changes.
events.source_span: showed no signal alterations in the medial temporal lobes, no acute vascular events, and no leptomeningeal enhancement; only mild cortical involutive changes were noted.

events.detail: A cerebrospinal fluid analysis was performed to evaluate for infection or other etiologies.
events.source_span: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis

events.detail: The CSF analysis was unremarkable for infection, showing a clear appearance, zero cells, glucose of 49 mg/dL, and protein of 68 mg/dL.
events.source_span: was unremarkable for infection, showing a clear appearance, zero cells per cubic millimeter, a glucose level of 49 mg/dL, and a protein level of 68 mg/dL.

events.detail: The patient developed progressive acute kidney injury requiring alternate-day renal replacement therapy.
events.source_span: Five days after ICU admission, the patient developed progressive acute kidney injury requiring alternate-day renal replacement therapy, without fulfilling urgent dialysis criteria.

events.detail: An empirical therapeutic trial with levetiracetam was initiated for suspected non-convulsive status epilepticus.
events.source_span: An empirical therapeutic trial with levetiracetam for suspected non-convulsive status epilepticus

events.detail: The levetiracetam trial yielded no clinical response.
events.source_span: yielded no clinical response.

events.detail: An 18F-FDG PET/CT of the brain was performed.
events.source_span: An 18F-FDG PET/CT of the brain was performed (Figure 1).

events.detail: The study showed marked bilateral hippocampal hypermetabolism and diffuse cortical hypometabolism with relative metabolic preservation of the primary motor and visual cortices (the 'tiara sign').
events.source_span: The study revealed marked bilateral hippocampal hypermetabolism, serving as a marker of active synaptic neuroinflammation. Furthermore, diffuse cortical hypometabolism was observed with relative metabolic preservation of the primary motor and visual cortices (the “tiara sign”)

events.detail: Histopathological examination of a lymph node and spleen biopsy was performed.
events.source_span: histopathological examination of a lymph node and spleen biopsy

events.summary: lymph node and spleen biopsy result
events.detail: The biopsy confirmed the diagnosis of mixed-cellularity classical Hodgkin lymphoma.
events.source_span: confirmed the diagnosis of mixed-cellularity classical HL.

events.detail: The diagnosis of Ophelia syndrome, likely mediated by anti-mGluR5 antibodies, was established.
events.source_span: The diagnosis of Ophelia syndrome was established, considered most likely mediated by anti-mGluR5 antibodies

events.detail: A contrast-enhanced abdominal CT was performed.
events.source_span: A contrast-enhanced abdominal CT (Figure 2)

events.detail: The CT demonstrated a bulky retroperitoneal lymph node conglomerate encasing major abdominal vessels, alongside focal splenic and pancreatic infiltration.
events.source_span: demonstrated a bulky retroperitoneal lymph node conglomerate encasing major abdominal vessels, alongside focal splenic and pancreatic infiltration

events.detail: Rescue immunosuppression with methylprednisolone pulses (1 gram per day for three days) was initiated.
events.source_span: rescue immunosuppression with methylprednisolone pulses (1 gram per day for three days) was initiated.

events.detail: Within 72 hours, the patient dramatically recovered wakefulness and the ability to follow complex commands.
events.source_span: Within 72 hours, the patient dramatically recovered wakefulness and the ability to follow complex commands.

events.detail: The patient started first-line ABVD (doxorubicin, bleomycin, vinblastine, and dacarbazine) chemotherapy.
events.source_span: He subsequently started first-line ABVD (doxorubicin, bleomycin, vinblastine, and dacarbazine) chemotherapy

events.detail: The patient achieved complete resolution of the neurological syndrome.
events.source_span: achieving complete resolution of the neurological syndrome.
